title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 113
description: Ten questions on Psalms 113: praise to Yahweh's name from sunrise to sunset, the God on high who lifts up the poor and gives the barren woman a home.

questions.text: Who are called to praise in the first verse?
questions.explanation: Psalms 113:1 says: praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh's name.

questions.text: For how long is Yahweh's name to be blessed?
questions.explanation: Psalms 113:2 says: blessed be Yahweh's name, from this time forward and forever more.

answers.text: For one generation and no longer
Only until the days of the king end
From this time forward and forever more
For seventy years and then no more

questions.text: From where to where is Yahweh's name to be praised?
questions.explanation: Psalms 113:3 says: from the rising of the sun to its going down, Yahweh's name is to be praised.

answers.text: From Dan in the north to Beersheba
From the rising of the sun to its going down
From the great river to the western sea
From the hills of Zion to Egypt

questions.text: Above what is Yahweh high, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Psalms 113:4 says Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

questions.text: Where does Yahweh, our God, have his seat?
questions.explanation: Psalms 113:5 asks: who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high?

questions.text: What does he do to see in heaven and in the earth?
questions.explanation: Psalms 113:6 says he stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth.

questions.text: Out of what does he raise up the poor?
questions.explanation: Psalms 113:7 says he raises up the poor out of the dust.

questions.text: From where does he lift up the needy?
questions.explanation: Psalms 113:7 says he lifts up the needy from the ash heap.

questions.text: With whom does he set the needy?
questions.explanation: Psalms 113:8 says he does this that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

questions.text: How does he settle the barren woman in her home?
questions.explanation: Psalms 113:9 says he settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children.

answers.text: As a rich widow with many fields
As a queen in a royal palace
As a joyful mother of children
As a servant in the house of princes
